readme.text: <div align="center">

把 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的会话、附件、设置和项目文件带到另一台电脑。
数据存放在你自己的 **私有 Git 仓库**中：默认 GitHub，也可以用 Gitee、GitLab 等。 [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/chatsync) [](#兼容性) [](#兼容性) [](#兼容性) [](LICENSE) [安装方式](#安装方式) · [更新方式](#更新方式) · [首次设置](#第一次设置) · [换台电脑](#换台电脑接着使用) · [详细指南](docs/getting-started.md) · [发布与下载](https://github.com/dpskk2/dsh-chatsync/releases/latest) · [English](README.en.md)

| 接着做的事 | 同步内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 接着聊 | 会话记录、聊天附件，以及会话与「工作区」的对应关系 |
| 接着做 | 项目文件夹中的文档、代码等文件 |
| 少配一遍 | 模型、界面设置；密钥、代理和本机路径各机保留；可选同步全局 AGENTS.md 与技能 |

先准备能正常打开的 DSH 和 [Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads/)。同步仓库放在 GitHub（默认）时，还需要 [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com/) 和可访问 GitHub 的网络；放在 Gitee、GitLab 等其他托管站时不需要 GitHub CLI，见[其他 Git 托管站](docs/configuration.md#其他-git-托管站)。

未手动指定代理时，同步优先使用环境变量，否则跟随当前 Windows 或 macOS 系统代理；更换系统代理端口无需重启。已保存的固定代理可以改为空或 `auto`，详见[代理配置](docs/configuration.md)。

**推荐：在 DSH 中安装。** 打开「插件」→「添加插件」，输入 `chatsync`。

也可使用命令行安装（Windows 用 PowerShell，macOS 用“终端”）：

**Web 端：**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add chatsync
```

**Windows 桌面端：**

以下命令适用于默认安装位置，自定义安装时请调整路径。

```powershell
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add chatsync
```

**macOS 桌面端：**

以下命令适用于安装在「应用程序」文件夹的情况，其他位置请调整路径。

```bash
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add chatsync
```

旧包名 `@dpskk2/dsh-chatsync` 继续提供同版本，原有安装可沿用，无需重复安装两个包名。
也可从 [GitHub Release](https://github.com/dpskk2/dsh-chatsync/releases/latest) 下载安装包，按[本地包安装指南](docs/getting-started.md#1-安装本地包)操作。

**如果原先安装的是 `@dpskk2/dsh-chatsync`，把命令中的 `chatsync` 换成原包名。** 插件更新提醒可关闭，不会自动安装更新。

**Web 端：**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web update chatsync
```

**Windows 桌面端：**

以下命令适用于默认安装位置，自定义安装时请调整路径。

```powershell
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop update chatsync
```

**macOS 桌面端：**

```bash
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop update chatsync
```

安装后重启 DSH，点击侧边栏「同步」，也可从「设置 → 同步」进入。

**① 登录托管站**

使用默认仓库（GitHub）时，在 PowerShell 中执行，按提示在浏览器完成授权：

```powershell
gh auth login --hostname github.com --git-protocol https --web
```

使用 Gitee、GitLab 等其他托管站时，先在网页创建空的私有仓库（不要勾选用 README 初始化），再运行一次下面的命令（换成你的仓库地址），在弹出的 Git 登录窗口输入该站的账号和密码或访问令牌；SSH 地址则先配置 SSH 密钥。

```powershell
git ls-remote https://gitee.com/用户名/dsh-sync.git
```

**② 同步仓库** — 点击「使用默认仓库并继续」。首次同步时自动创建或复用 `dsh-sync` 私有仓库；使用已有仓库则点击「使用其他仓库」，填写 GitHub、Gitee、GitLab 等托管站的私有仓库地址（HTTPS 或 SSH）。

**③ 选择内容** — 按需勾选，修改即时保存。首次连接先手动使用，之后可开启自动同步。[完整同步范围与排除规则](docs/sync-content.md)

**④ 首次同步** — 点击「立即同步」，等待完成。确认上传成功后再换电脑；只生成本地快照不代表已经上传。

1. 原电脑同步成功后，在新电脑安装插件，并按「第一次设置」登录同一托管站账号。
2. 打开「同步」，使用默认仓库；自定义仓库时，两台电脑使用相同仓库与分支。
3. 同步取回后，检查会话、附件和项目文件，配置本机模型 API 密钥。界面提示需要重启时，完全退出后重新打开。

其他插件和项目依赖需另装；项目目录不同可在同步设置中调整本机保存位置。在 Windows 与 macOS 之间共用仓库时，macOS 打不开 Windows 上建的会话（工作目录是 Windows 路径），这类会话不导入、远端保留，不影响其他内容同步。macOS 上建的会话可以导入 Windows 查看，继续对话前需要按提示换到本机项目。macOS 桌面端不支持自动重启，需要刷新会话列表时会提示手动退出再打开。[详细指南](docs/getting-started.md#4-换台电脑接着使用)

点击侧边栏「同步」→「立即同步」。

开启自动同步后，会在启动和正常退出时运行。

启动同步期间可正常新建会话、工作区和编辑草稿。旧会话若提示等待，请在核对完成后再次发送；文字与附件会保留。

- **查看冲突内容：** 选择文件，点击「查看内容」。会话默认按用户与助手消息阅读，设置和会话列表信息按字段显示；需要排查时可切换「查看原始记录」。项目文件可选择版本恢复，会话分叉可另存为独立会话。
- **会话与数据修复：** 在同步页打开处理页面，查看检查结果、预览方案并确认；需要退出 DSH 的修复会明确提示，原件和备份会保留。
- **分组检查：** 会话分组异常时，可在同步页查看检查结果与处理方案。

[冲突与恢复](docs/configuration.md#冲突原件与项目文件恢复) · [历史数据修复与会话分支](docs/data-repair-0.20.1.md)

聊天、附件或项目文件中写入的密钥等敏感信息需自行处理，可用[排除规则](docs/sync-content.md)控制同步范围。本机凭据、锁、缓存及运行状态不参与传输。

会话分叉会保留为独立版本。远端删除不会直接删除本机会话。重要资料请另留备份。[同步与恢复边界](docs/configuration.md)

**同步仓库与本机存储（实验性）：** 点「检查」后，每行以「明细」打开详情。首次同步只取当前快照；旧 Git 历史保留在同步仓库，不再自动下载整段历史。本机把当前同步副本、必要的恢复原件、旧版本遗留分开显示；清除历史时旧内容留在同步仓库的归档分支，不生成完整本机备份。[同步范围](docs/sync-content.md#同步仓库与本机存储) · [本机存储](docs/local-storage.md)

上次同步详情中的「本机同步副本（含历史）」统计本机 Git 对象的占用，不代表本次传输量或新电脑下载量。清除历史会回收当前同步副本中已归档的旧历史；本机独有分支继续保留。早先版本清除历史后留在本机的同步前备份会显示为「本机另存旧历史」，同步仓库仍保有时可在同步仓库明细中「回收本机空间」。历史检查复用已缓存的设备回执，最多等待 2 分钟，失败时说明具体阶段。

已核对且旧会话已归档的迁移原件可手动清理；旧仓库中尚未被当前副本覆盖的提交（含 reflog 历史）仍受保护。

支持 DSH 的 Web 和 Windows、macOS 桌面端，最低 **0.2.0-rc.1**（macOS 没有真机验收记录，会话日志格式和设置已按 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 的官方源码核对，见[文件说明](docs/dsh-file-catalog.md)）；桌面端推荐 **0.2.1-rc.3 或更新版**。独立运行要求 **Node.js 24 或更新版**，桌面端使用应用自带运行时。

具体已验证与未覆盖范围见[本版验证记录](docs/release-0.21.2-validation.md)。

[安装与使用](docs/getting-started.md) · [配置与恢复](docs/configuration.md) · [同步范围](docs/sync-content.md) · [文件说明](docs/dsh-file-catalog.md) · [提交问题](https://github.com/dpskk2/dsh-chatsync/issues)

开发需要 Node.js 24 和 Git，原生 ESM，无运行时 npm 依赖：

```powershell
npm test
npm pack --dry-run
```

<div align="center">

Bring your DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sessions, attachments, settings and project files to another computer.
Your data stays in your own **private Git repository**: GitHub by default, or Gitee, GitLab and other Git hosts. [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/chatsync) [](#compatibility) [](#compatibility) [](#compatibility) [](LICENSE)

[Installation](#installation) · [Updating](#updating) · [First setup](#first-setup) · [Moving to another computer](#moving-to-another-computer) · [Detailed guide](docs/getting-started.md) · [Releases and downloads](https://github.com/dpskk2/dsh-chatsync/releases/latest) · [中文](README.md)

| Pick up where you left off | What gets synced |
| --- | --- |
| Continue the conversation | Session history, chat attachments and the links between sessions and workspaces |
| Continue the work | Documents, code and other files in your project folders |
| Set up less | Model and interface settings; keys, proxies and local paths stay on each computer; optionally the global AGENTS.md and skills |

First, make sure DSH opens normally. Install [Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads/). When the sync repository is on GitHub (the default), also install [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com/) and use a network connection that can reach GitHub. Other Git hosts such as Gitee or GitLab do not need GitHub CLI; see [Other Git hosts](docs/configuration.md#其他-git-托管站).

Without a manually specified proxy, sync uses proxy environment variables first, then the current Windows or macOS system proxy. Changing the system proxy port requires no restart. Set a previously saved fixed proxy to an empty string or `auto` to enable automatic selection; see [proxy configuration](docs/configuration.md).

**Recommended: install in DSH.** Open **Plugins → Add Plugin** and enter `chatsync`.

You can also install from the command line (PowerShell on Windows, Terminal on macOS):

**Web:**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add chatsync
```

**Windows Desktop:**

This command uses the default installation location. Adjust the path if you installed DSH elsewhere.

```powershell
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add chatsync
```

**macOS Desktop:**

This command assumes DSH is in the Applications folder. Adjust the path if it is elsewhere.

```bash
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add chatsync
```

The previous package name, `@dpskk2/dsh-chatsync`, continues to receive the same versions. Existing installations can keep using it; there is no need to install both names.

You can also download a package from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/dpskk2/dsh-chatsync/releases/latest) and follow the [local package installation guide](docs/getting-started.md#1-安装本地包).

**If you originally installed `@dpskk2/dsh-chatsync`, replace `chatsync` in the commands with that package name.** Update notices can be turned off and never install updates automatically.

**Web:**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web update chatsync
```

**Windows Desktop:**

This command uses the default installation location. Adjust the path if you installed DSH elsewhere.

```powershell
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop update chatsync
```

**macOS Desktop:**

```bash
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop update chatsync
```

Restart DSH after installation. Click **Sync** in the sidebar, or open **Settings → Sync**.

**① Sign in to your Git host**

For the default repository (GitHub), run this in PowerShell and follow the prompts to authorize access in your browser:

```powershell
gh auth login --hostname github.com --git-protocol https --web
```

For Gitee, GitLab or another host, first create an empty private repository on its website (do not initialize it with a README). Then run the command below once with your repository address and sign in with that site's account and password or access token in the Git sign-in window. For an SSH address, set up an SSH key instead.

```powershell
git ls-remote https://gitee.com/username/dsh-sync.git
```

**② Sync repository** — Click **Use default repository and continue**. The first sync automatically creates or reuses the private `dsh-sync` repository. To use an existing repository, click **Use another repository** and enter the HTTPS or SSH address of a private repository on GitHub, Gitee, GitLab or another Git host.

**③ Choose content** — Select what you need; changes save immediately. Start manually when first connecting, then enable automatic sync if you want it. [Full sync scope and exclusion rules](docs/sync-content.md)

**④ First sync** — Click **Sync now** and wait for it to finish. Confirm that the upload succeeded before switching computers; a local snapshot alone does not mean your data has been uploaded.

1. After a successful sync on the original computer, install the plugin on the new computer and sign in to the same account on your Git host, as in First setup.
2. Open **Sync** and use the default repository. For a custom repository, use the same repository and branch on both computers.
3. After syncing to retrieve your data, check your sessions, attachments and project files, and configure this computer's model API keys. If prompted to restart, fully exit DSH and open it again.

Other plugins and project dependencies need to be installed separately. If project folders are in different locations, adjust their local save locations in Sync settings. When Windows and macOS share a repository, macOS cannot open sessions created on Windows (their working folder is a Windows path); those sessions are not imported there and stay on the remote, and everything else keeps syncing. Sessions created on macOS can be imported into Windows for reading; continuing one requires moving it to a local project when prompted. macOS Desktop does not restart automatically: when the session list needs refreshing you are asked to quit and reopen it. [Detailed guide](docs/getting-started.md#4-换台电脑接着使用)

Click **Sync → Sync now** in the sidebar.

When automatic sync is enabled, it runs at startup and after a normal exit.

During startup sync, you can create sessions and workspaces and edit drafts as usual. If an older session asks you to wait, send again after verification finishes; your text and attachments are retained.

- **View conflicts:** Select a file and click **View content**. Conversations show user and assistant messages by default; settings and session-list information use readable fields. Switch to the original records when troubleshooting. For project files, choose a version to restore; a divergent conversation can be saved as a separate session.
- **Session and data repair:** Open the processing page from Sync, review the checks, preview a plan and confirm. Repairs that require exiting DSH say so explicitly; originals and backups are retained.
- **Grouping checks:** If session grouping looks wrong, view the checks and proposed fixes on the Sync page.
[Conflicts and recovery](docs/configuration.md#冲突原件与项目文件恢复) · [Legacy data repair and session branches](docs/data-repair-0.20.1.md)

You are responsible for handling keys and other sensitive information written into chats, attachments or project files. Use [exclusion rules](docs/sync-content.md) to control what gets synced. Local credentials, locks, caches and runtime state are excluded from transfers.

Divergent conversations are retained as separate versions. Remote deletion does not directly delete local sessions. Keep separate backups of important material. [Sync and recovery boundaries](docs/configuration.md)

**Sync repository and local storage (experimental):** Each row opens Details. First sync downloads only the current snapshot. Older Git history stays in the sync repository; clearing history archives it there without creating a full local backup. Local storage separates active transport data, recovery originals, and legacy material. [Sync scope](docs/sync-content.md#同步仓库与本机存储) · [Local storage](docs/local-storage.md)

“Local sync copy (including history)” in the last sync details measures local Git objects, including loose objects. It is not the transfer size or the download size for a new computer. Clearing history reclaims archived history from the active local copy while preserving local-only branches. Pre-sync backups that an earlier version left in the local copy after clearing appear as “old history kept locally”; when the sync repository still holds them, use “Reclaim local space” in the repository details. History checks reuse cached device receipts, wait up to two minutes, and identify the stage that failed.

Migration originals can be cleaned manually after verification and archiving of the old session. Old repositories remain protected when they contain commits, including reflog history, that the current copy does not cover.

Supports DSH Web and Windows and macOS Desktop, with a minimum version of **0.2.0-rc.1** (macOS has no real-device acceptance record; the session log format and settings were reviewed against the official DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 source, see [file notes](docs/dsh-file-catalog.md)). **Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3 or newer is recommended**. Standalone use requires **Node.js 24 or newer**; Desktop uses its bundled runtime.
See the [version validation record](docs/release-0.21.2-validation.md) for the environments actually tested and the remaining gaps.

[Installation and use](docs/getting-started.md) · [Configuration and recovery](docs/configuration.md) · [Sync scope](docs/sync-content.md) · [File catalog](docs/dsh-file-catalog.md) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/dpskk2/dsh-chatsync/issues)

Development requires Node.js 24 and Git. The source uses native ESM with no runtime npm dependencies:

```powershell
npm test
npm pack --dry-run
```
